title: Shared finite-index splitting along an injection
statement: For a type κ with decidable equality and an injection ρ : Fin r → κ, PadicAlgCl.sumComplEquiv ρ hρ is the equivalence κ ≃ Fin r ⊕ {i // i ∉ Set.range ρ} obtained by splitting the range of ρ and identifying that range with Fin r. Its inverse sends Sum.inl a to ρ a. This includes r = 0 and empty κ.

proof.text: Compose (Equiv.sumCompl (· ∈ Set.range ρ)).symm with the sum of (Equiv.ofInjective ρ hρ).symm and the identity on the complement. On the left summand, Mathlib simplification of inverse composition, sumCongr, ofInjective and sumCompl yields ρ a. These are the existing definition and proof from UnitMatrix, moved without changing their types or bodies.
